sql: SELECT index_id, value, avail_season, avail_doy FROM climate WHERE avail_season=2 ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT count(*) as n, min(fish_date_season) as min_s, max(fish_date_season) as max_s FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=2

SELECT cls, fish_date_doy/30 as month_bin, count(*) n, avg(yt*1.0/anglers) avg_rate, sum(case when yt=0 then 1 else 0 end)*1.0/count(*) pct_zero FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=2 GROUP BY cls, month_bin ORDER BY month_bin, cls
SELECT avail_season, avg(value) v, min(value) mn, max(value) mx, count(*) n FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni' GROUP BY avail_season ORDER BY avail_season
